```text
161	def parse_types_arg(spec: str | None) -> int | None:
162	    """Resolve a `--types` spec to a u32 mask. Returns None if `spec` is None.
163	
164	    Accepts a comma-separated list of RecordType names plus the special tokens
165	    `ALL` (0xFFFFFFFF) and `MIN` (SESSION|DROP). Case-insensitive.
166	    """
167	    if spec is None:
168	        return None
169	    mask = 0
170	    for raw in spec.split(","):
171	        token = raw.strip().upper()
172	        if not token:
173	            continue
174	        if token == "ALL":
175	            return TYPE_MASK_ALL
176	        if token == "MIN":
177	            mask |= TYPE_MASK_MIN
178	            continue
179	        if token not in RECORD_TYPE_BY_NAME:
180	            valid = ", ".join(sorted(RECORD_TYPE_BY_NAME))
181	            raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(
182	                f"unknown record type {token!r}; valid: {valid}, ALL, MIN"
183	            )
184	        mask |= 1 << RECORD_TYPE_BY_NAME[token]
185	    return mask

225	def _live_loop(records: Iterator[Record], stats: FrameStats) -> int:
226	    last_status = time.monotonic()
227	    record_count = 0
228	    drop_records = 0
229	    drop_baseline = _DropBaseline()

237	            print(

239	                f"fcs_err={stats.fcs_mismatches} drop_recs={drop_records}",
240	                file=sys.stderr,
241	                flush=True,
242	            )
243	            last_status = now
244	    return 0

248	    """Accept either a capture directory or a bare .bin and return the bin."""

258	def cmd_record(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
259	    """Pure pass-through to disk; no decode.

261	    Two modes: `--out FILE.bin` writes a raw legacy file; `--out-dir DIR`
262	    writes a capture directory (DIR/perf.bin + manifest.json finalized on
263	    close).
264	    """
265	    if (args.out is None) == (args.out_dir is None):
266	        print("record: exactly one of --out or --out-dir is required", file=sys.stderr)
267	        return 2
268	
269	    if args.out_dir is not None:
270	        cap_dir = init_capture_dir(args.out_dir, exist_ok=False)
271	        bin_path = cap_dir / BIN_NAME
272	        label = f"capture {cap_dir.name}/"
273	    else:

275	        bin_path = Path(args.out)
276	        label = f"recording {bin_path.name}"

278	    mask = parse_types_arg(args.types)

280	    last_status = time.monotonic()
281	    with SerialSource(args.port) as ser, bin_path.open("wb") as fh:
282	        if mask is not None:
283	            _send_mask(ser, mask)
284	        try:
285	            for chunk in ser:
286	                fh.write(chunk)
287	                fh.flush()

289	                now = time.monotonic()

291	                    print(f"{label}: {bytes_written} B", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
292	                    last_status = now
293	        except KeyboardInterrupt:
294	            print(f"\nstopped after {bytes_written} B", file=sys.stderr)
295	
296	    if cap_dir is not None:

298	            cap_dir,
299	            source=CaptureSource(kind="serial", port=args.port),
300	        )

303	            f"types={manifest.producer_capabilities}",
304	            file=sys.stderr,

425	def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:

432	    p_live = sub.add_parser("live", help="Live decode from a USB-CDC serial port.")

434	    p_live.add_argument("--also-record", help="Optionally also write raw bytes to FILE")
435	    p_live.add_argument("--types", help=_types_help())
436	    p_live.set_defaults(func=cmd_live)
437	
438	    p_record = sub.add_parser("record", help="Capture raw bytes (no decode).")
439	    p_record.add_argument("--port", required=True)
440	    p_record.add_argument("--out", help="Write a bare .bin (legacy)")
441	    p_record.add_argument("--out-dir", help="Write a capture directory (perf.bin + manifest.json)")
442	    p_record.add_argument("--types", help=_types_help())
443	    p_record.set_defaults(func=cmd_record)
444	
445	    p_set_mask = sub.add_parser(

448	    )

450	    p_set_mask.add_argument("--types", required=True, help=_types_help())
451	    p_set_mask.set_defaults(func=cmd_set_mask)
452	
453	    p_decode = sub.add_parser(
454	        "decode", help="Pretty-print every record in a capture (.bin or directory)."
455	    )
456	    p_decode.add_argument("path")
457	    p_decode.set_defaults(func=cmd_decode)
458	
459	    p_summary = sub.add_parser(
460	        "summarize", help="Run analysis pass over a capture (.bin or directory)."
461	    )
462	    p_summary.add_argument("path")
463	    p_summary.set_defaults(func=cmd_summarize)
464	
465	    p_serve = sub.add_parser(
466	        "serve", help="Run the visual review server (requires viewer dep group)."
467	    )
468	    p_serve.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")

476	    return p
```

```text
143	    def set_mask_from_int(self, mask: int) -> int:
144	        m = mask & 0xFFFFFFFF

282	    async def attach_ws(self, ws: WebSocket) -> None:
283	        with self._lock:
284	            if self._ws is not None:
285	                await ws.close(code=4409, reason="live already in use")
286	                return
287	            if not self.is_active():

291	            self._queue = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=_QUEUE_MAX)
292	            self._ws = ws

294	        await ws.accept()
295	        with self._lock:
296	            hello = {
297	                "type": "hello",
298	                "session": {
299	                    "started_at": self._state.started_at,
300	                    "port": self._state.port,

302	                    "recording": self._recording_dict_locked(),

304	            }
305	            replay = self._state.last_session_dict
306	        try:

308	            if replay is not None:
309	                await ws.send_json({"type": "session_replay", "rec": replay})

312	                msg_type, payload = await queue.get()
313	                if msg_type == "record":
314	                    await ws.send_json({"type": "record", "rec": payload})
315	                elif msg_type == "mask":
316	                    await ws.send_json({"type": "mask", **payload})
317	                elif msg_type == "error":
318	                    await ws.send_json({"type": "error", **payload})
319	                    break
320	                elif msg_type == "framing_stats":
321	                    await ws.send_json({"type": "framing_stats", **payload})

333	    def _reader_loop(self) -> None:
334	        ser = self._ser
335	        stats = self._state.framing_stats
336	        if ser is None:
337	            return
338	        try:
339	            for frame in iter_frames(ser, stats):
340	                if self._stop_event.is_set():
341	                    break
342	                self._mirror_to_recording(frame.framed)
343	                try:
344	                    rec = decode_record(frame.payload)
345	                except Exception:
346	                    continue
347	                if self._record_to_dict is None:
348	                    continue
349	                rec_dict = self._record_to_dict(rec, include_bgr=True)
350	                if isinstance(rec, Session):
351	                    with self._lock:
352	                        self._state.last_session_dict = rec_dict
353	                self._post("record", rec_dict)
354	        except Exception as e:
355	            self._post("error", {"code": "serial-error", "msg": str(e)})
356	        finally:
357	            # Reader exit (clean stop or serial error): finalize any
358	            # active recording so the bin is left in an openable state.
359	            try:
360	                self.record_stop()
361	            except Exception:
362	                pass
363	
364	    def _mirror_to_recording(self, framed: bytes) -> None:
365	        """Reader-thread tap: write validated framed bytes to the active
366	        recording, if any. Disable the recording on write failure rather
367	        than tear down the whole session."""
368	        with self._lock:
369	            rec = self._rec
370	            if rec is None:
371	                return
372	            try:
373	                rec.fh.write(framed)
374	                rec.bytes_written += len(framed)
375	                rec.n_frames += 1
376	                return
377	            except OSError as e:
378	                self._rec = None
379	                err_msg = str(e)
380	                fh = rec.fh
381	        try:
382	            fh.close()
383	        except Exception:
384	            pass
385	        self._post("error", {"code": "record-write", "msg": err_msg})
386	
387	    # ─── internal: cross-thread queue post ──────────────────────────────
388	
389	    def _post(self, msg_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
390	        loop = self._loop
391	        queue = self._queue
392	        if loop is None or queue is None:
393	            return
394	        try:
395	            loop.call_soon_threadsafe(self._queue_put_nowait, msg_type, payload)
396	        except RuntimeError:
397	            pass
398	
399	    def _queue_put_nowait(self, msg_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
400	        # Runs on the asyncio loop thread (single producer/consumer here).
401	        # On overflow, drop the oldest item so the WS receiver always sees
402	        # the freshest data — useful when STRIP records swamp the link.
403	        if self._queue is None:
404	            return
405	        try:
406	            self._queue.put_nowait((msg_type, payload))
407	        except asyncio.QueueFull:
408	            try:
409	                self._queue.get_nowait()
410	            except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
411	                return
412	            try:
413	                self._queue.put_nowait((msg_type, payload))
414	            except asyncio.QueueFull:
415	                pass
416	
417	    def _drain_queue(self) -> None:
418	        loop = self._loop
419	        if loop is None:
420	            return
421	        try:
422	            loop.call_soon_threadsafe(self._queue_drain)
423	        except RuntimeError:
424	            pass
425	
426	    def _queue_drain(self) -> None:
427	        if self._queue is None:
428	            return
429	        while True:
430	            try:
431	                self._queue.get_nowait()
432	            except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
433	                return
```

```text
109	/* PERF_REC_TIMING — per-frame snapshot of timing_pipeline internal state.
110	 * v3 widens the v2 counts-only record into a full snapshot so the host
111	 * can answer "why did it publish that mask at frame N" by replaying
112	 * detector events forward through the visible queue state. All *_at_ms
113	 * deadlines are deltas from the same now_ms field; chord_age_ms is
114	 * (now_ms - chord_start_ms) for the currently-open chord window. Counts
115	 * are 0..TP_FIFO_CAP (32 today). Masks use the same TIMING_BIT_* bit
116	 * layout as the wire byte to fretboard. */
117	typedef struct __attribute__((packed))
118	{
119	    perf_hdr_t hdr;
120	    uint32_t   now_ms;                /* timing pipeline clock */

122	    uint8_t    chord_mask;            /* mask accumulated in the open window */
123	    uint16_t   chord_age_ms;          /* now_ms - chord_start_ms when open */
124	    uint8_t    note_q_count;
125	    uint8_t    note_head_mask;        /* mask of front-of-queue (next to fire) */
126	    uint8_t    note_tail_mask;        /* union of all queued note masks */
127	    uint8_t    reserved;
128	    uint32_t   note_head_at_ms;       /* assert_at_ms of front-of-queue */
129	    uint8_t    strum_q_count;
130	    uint8_t    strum_head_mask;
131	    uint8_t    strum_dir_next;        /* 0=none, 1=down, 2=up — next strum */
132	    uint8_t    reserved2;
133	    uint32_t   strum_head_at_ms;      /* strum_at_ms of front-of-queue */
134	    uint8_t    frets_active;          /* asserted mask, pre-strum overlay */
135	    uint8_t    strum_active;          /* 0/1 — strum pulse currently held */
136	    uint8_t    release_pending_mask;  /* frets with pending release timer */
137	    uint8_t    publish_mask;          /* final wire output mask */
138	    uint32_t   strum_release_at_ms;   /* deadline for current strum pulse */
139	    uint32_t   release_min_at_ms;     /* earliest pending-release deadline */
140	} perf_rec_timing_t;
```

```text
"""CLI argument parsing — record-type mask spec resolution."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse

import pytest

from marvin_perf.cli import parse_types_arg
from marvin_perf.records import RecordType


def test_types_none_returns_none() -> None:
    assert parse_types_arg(None) is None


def test_types_flag_parses() -> None:
    mask = parse_types_arg("STAMP,SESSION")
    assert mask == (1 << RecordType.SESSION) | (1 << RecordType.STAMP)


def test_types_case_insensitive_and_whitespace() -> None:
    assert parse_types_arg("stamp, session") == parse_types_arg("STAMP,SESSION")


def test_types_all_token() -> None:
    assert parse_types_arg("ALL") == 0xFFFFFFFF


def test_types_min_token() -> None:
    expected = (1 << RecordType.SESSION) | (1 << RecordType.DROP)
    assert parse_types_arg("MIN") == expected


def test_types_min_combines_with_more() -> None:
    expected = (1 << RecordType.SESSION) | (1 << RecordType.DROP) | (1 << RecordType.STAMP)
    assert parse_types_arg("MIN,STAMP") == expected


def test_types_unknown_raises() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(argparse.ArgumentTypeError):
        parse_types_arg("BOGUS")
```

```text
1	# marvin-perf
2	
3	Host-side decoder and analyzer for the marvin firmware **perf-log** wire format.
4	
5	The firmware emits framed binary records (schema version 1) over its USB-device
6	CDC ACM port. This tool consumes that stream live, records it to disk, replays
7	captures offline, and produces summary analyses (latency attribution, drop
8	accounting, stack high-water trends).
9	
10	Wire format source-of-truth lives in the firmware tree at
11	[`firmware/marvin/default/src/perf_log/perf_log_records.h`](../../firmware/marvin/default/src/perf_log/perf_log_records.h).
12	The Python schema mirror in [`marvin_perf/records.py`](marvin_perf/records.py)
13	must match it byte-for-byte; bump `PERF_LOG_SCHEMA_VERSION` on both sides
14	together.
15	
16	## Setup
17	
18	All Python work runs through [**uv**](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). First-time
19	bootstrap:
20	
21	    cd tools/marvin-perf
22	    uv sync --group viewer   # include viewer deps for the serve command
23	
24	`uv sync` creates `.venv/` and writes `uv.lock`. Subsequent invocations use the
25	existing venv automatically. Omit `--group viewer` if you only need the CLI
26	decode/record commands.
27	
28	## Usage
29	
30	    # Launch the visual review server (default when no subcommand is given)
31	    uv run marvin-perf
32	    uv run marvin-perf serve
33	    uv run marvin-perf serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8765
34	    uv run marvin-perf serve --capture session.bin   # pre-load a capture on startup
35	
36	    # Live decode from the marvin USB-device CDC port
37	    uv run marvin-perf live --port /dev/cu.usbmodem...
38	
39	    # Live decode and capture raw bytes to disk in parallel
40	    uv run marvin-perf live --port /dev/cu.usbmodem... --also-record session.bin
41	
42	    # Capture raw bytes only (no decode)
43	    uv run marvin-perf record --port /dev/cu.usbmodem... --out session.bin
44	
45	    # Pretty-print every record in a captured file
46	    uv run marvin-perf decode session.bin
47	
48	    # Run the full analysis pass over a captured file
49	    uv run marvin-perf summarize session.bin
50	
51	## Tests
52	
53	    uv run pytest
54	
55	Fixtures under [`tests/fixtures/`](tests/fixtures/) are hand-built byte streams
56	covering one frame per record type plus framing edge cases (FCS mismatch,
57	truncated payload, mid-stream join needing SOF resync).
58
```

```python
"""Command-line entry point: serve / record / set-mask.

`serve` (the default) launches the visual review server. `record` and
`set-mask` are headless helpers — capture raw bytes from a serial port and
push a type-mask command to a running device respectively.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

from .capture import (
    BIN_NAME,
    CaptureSource,
    finalize_capture_dir,
    init_capture_dir,
)
from .framing import frame_encode
from .records import (
    RECORD_TYPE_BY_NAME,
    TYPE_MASK_ALL,
    TYPE_MASK_MIN,
    encode_set_mask_payload,
)
from .transport import SerialSource


# ─── Type-mask CLI parsing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────


def parse_types_arg(spec: str | None) -> int | None:
    """Resolve a `--types` spec to a u32 mask. Returns None if `spec` is None.

    Accepts a comma-separated list of RecordType names plus the special tokens
    `ALL` (0xFFFFFFFF) and `MIN` (SESSION|DROP). Case-insensitive.
    """
    if spec is None:
        return None
    mask = 0
    for raw in spec.split(","):
        token = raw.strip().upper()
        if not token:
            continue
        if token == "ALL":
            return TYPE_MASK_ALL
        if token == "MIN":
            mask |= TYPE_MASK_MIN
            continue
        if token not in RECORD_TYPE_BY_NAME:
            valid = ", ".join(sorted(RECORD_TYPE_BY_NAME))
            raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(
                f"unknown record type {token!r}; valid: {valid}, ALL, MIN"
            )
        mask |= 1 << RECORD_TYPE_BY_NAME[token]
    return mask


def _types_help() -> str:
    bit_lines = ", ".join(
        f"{name}={int(rt)}" for name, rt in sorted(RECORD_TYPE_BY_NAME.items())
    )
    return (
        "Comma-separated record types to enable on the device. "
        f"Names: {bit_lines}. Special: ALL (default), MIN (SESSION+DROP). "
        "SESSION is always emitted regardless of mask. Old firmware ignores the command."
    )


def _send_mask(ser: SerialSource, mask: int) -> None:
    payload = encode_set_mask_payload(mask)
    ser.send_command(frame_encode(payload))
    print(f"[mask] sent 0x{mask:08x}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)


# ─── Subcommands ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def cmd_record(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    """Pure pass-through to disk; no decode.

    Two modes: `--out FILE.bin` writes a raw legacy file; `--out-dir DIR`
    writes a capture directory (DIR/perf.bin + manifest.json finalized on
    close).
    """
    if (args.out is None) == (args.out_dir is None):
        print("record: exactly one of --out or --out-dir is required", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    if args.out_dir is not None:
        cap_dir = init_capture_dir(args.out_dir, exist_ok=False)
        bin_path = cap_dir / BIN_NAME
        label = f"capture {cap_dir.name}/"
    else:
        cap_dir = None
        bin_path = Path(args.out)
        label = f"recording {bin_path.name}"

    mask = parse_types_arg(args.types)
    bytes_written = 0
    last_status = time.monotonic()
    with SerialSource(args.port) as ser, bin_path.open("wb") as fh:
        if mask is not None:
            _send_mask(ser, mask)
        try:
            for chunk in ser:
                fh.write(chunk)
                fh.flush()
                bytes_written += len(chunk)
                now = time.monotonic()
                if (now - last_status) >= 1.0:
                    print(f"{label}: {bytes_written} B", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
                    last_status = now
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print(f"\nstopped after {bytes_written} B", file=sys.stderr)

    if cap_dir is not None:
        manifest = finalize_capture_dir(
            cap_dir,
            source=CaptureSource(kind="serial", port=args.port),
        )
        print(
            f"finalized {cap_dir}/manifest.json — {manifest.n_records} records, "
            f"types={manifest.producer_capabilities}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
    return 0


def cmd_set_mask(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    mask = parse_types_arg(args.types)
    if mask is None:
        print("set-mask: --types is required", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    with SerialSource(args.port) as ser:
        _send_mask(ser, mask)
    return 0


def cmd_serve(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    try:
        from .web.server import run as run_server
    except ImportError as e:
        print(
            "marvin-perf serve requires the 'viewer' dep group.\n"
            "  uv sync --group viewer\n"
            f"  (import error: {e})",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        return 2
    return run_server(host=args.host, port=args.port, capture=args.capture)


# ─── Argparse wiring ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="marvin-perf",
        description="marvin perf-log: visual review server + headless capture helpers.",
    )
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="command")

    p_record = sub.add_parser("record", help="Capture raw bytes (no decode).")
    p_record.add_argument("--port", required=True)
    p_record.add_argument("--out", help="Write a bare .bin (legacy)")
    p_record.add_argument("--out-dir", help="Write a capture directory (perf.bin + manifest.json)")
    p_record.add_argument("--types", help=_types_help())
    p_record.set_defaults(func=cmd_record)

    p_set_mask = sub.add_parser(
        "set-mask",
        help="Send a SET_TYPE_MASK command to a running device and exit.",
    )
    p_set_mask.add_argument("--port", required=True)
    p_set_mask.add_argument("--types", required=True, help=_types_help())
    p_set_mask.set_defaults(func=cmd_set_mask)

    p_serve = sub.add_parser(
        "serve", help="Run the visual review server (requires viewer dep group)."
    )
    p_serve.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    p_serve.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8765)
    p_serve.add_argument(
        "--capture",
        help="Optional capture path (directory or .bin) to pre-load on startup.",
    )
    p_serve.set_defaults(func=cmd_serve)

    return p


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.command is None:
        args = parser.parse_args(["serve"])
    return args.func(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```
